cards.front: Recall a key point about The Punic Wars & Hannibal
cards.back: The three Punic Wars (264-146 BC) were fought between Rome and Carthage for control of the Western Mediterranean

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Punic Wars & Hannibal
cards.back: First Punic War (264-241 BC): Rome built its first navy and won Sicily as its first province

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Punic Wars & Hannibal
cards.back: Second Punic War (218-201 BC): Hannibal crossed the Alps with elephants, won at Cannae (216 BC) but was eventually defeated by Scipio at Zama (202 BC)

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Punic Wars & Hannibal
cards.back: The Battle of Cannae was Rome's worst military defeat: perhaps 50,000-70,000 Romans died in a single day

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Punic Wars & Hannibal
cards.back: Third Punic War (149-146 BC): Carthage was destroyed; the city was burned and its territory became a Roman province

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Punic Wars & Hannibal
cards.back: Cato the Elder ended every speech with 'Carthago delenda est' (Carthage must be destroyed)
